title: feat(v0.2): per-segment + hybrid modes, FluentCRM and Groundhogg adapters
body:
## Summary

Implements the v0.2 roadmap from #1.

- **Per-segment mode**: one AI call per audience segment (default keys: `country`, `language`), shared cache across all recipients in the segment. Audience of 100 across 3 countries → 3 AI calls.
- **Hybrid mode**: AI decides per-segment vs per-recipient once per campaign; decision is cached.
- **FluentCRM adapter**: hooks `fluent_crm/email_data_before_headers` (subject + HTML body) and `fluentcrm_email_body_text` (defence-in-depth body filter). Verified against FluentCRM developer docs.
- **Groundhogg adapter**: hooks `groundhogg/email/before_send` (by-reference subject + content rewrite). Verified against Groundhogg trunk `includes/classes/email.php` line 1294.

Resolves #1.

## Files

**New**
- `includes/Personalization/SegmentPlanner.php` — segment ID derivation, `personalize_for_segment()`, `should_segment()` for hybrid.
- `includes/Adapters/FluentCRM/FluentCrmAdapter.php` — `PersonalizationProviderInterface` impl.
- `includes/Adapters/Groundhogg/GroundhoggAdapter.php` — `PersonalizationProviderInterface` impl.

**Changed**
- `includes/Personalization/Personalizer.php` — branches on `Settings::mode()` and dispatches to `SegmentPlanner` for per-segment / hybrid; falls through to existing per-recipient path otherwise. Single entry point for every adapter.
- `includes/Core/Settings.php` — adds `segment_keys` default (`[country, language]`).
- `includes/Core/Plugin.php` — registers the two new adapters next to `NewsletterAdapter`.
- `includes/Adapters/Newsletter/NewsletterAdapter.php` — accepts `MODE_PER_SEGMENT` (segmentation now happens inside the `Personalizer`).
- `includes/Admin/SettingsPage.php` — host-detection rows for FluentCRM and Groundhogg, configurable `segment_keys` text field, updated mode help text.

## Verification

- `composer phpcs` → 0 errors. Two pre-existing warnings (`$default`, `$match` reserved-keyword params) remain, unchanged by this PR.
- `php -l` clean across every modified and new file.
- Adapter contract is preserved: each new adapter implements `PersonalizationProviderInterface`, short-circuits when its host plugin is not active, and calls only `Personalizer::personalize()`.

## Behaviour

- Mode branching is internal to `Personalizer` — every adapter keeps using the same per-recipient hooks. Per-segment mode reuses the cache key shape with a synthetic `__segment__$kind` content kind and a hashed segment ID in place of `subscriber_id`, so it cannot collide with the per-recipient cache.
- Hybrid decision is cached per `(provider × campaign × prompt_hash)` and costs at most one extra AI call per campaign. Defaults to per-recipient (the safer, higher-quality path) on any error.
- Cost tracking and WaaS / network-admin remain explicitly out of scope per the issue.

## Out of scope (per #1)

- Cost tracking.
- Network-admin surface.
- Mailster, MailPoet, AcyMailing, Email Subscribers adapters.

title: chore(phpcs): switch to short array syntax + drop alignment-noise rules
body:
## Summary

Per-project preference: switch the WPCS ruleset to modern short array syntax `[]` and drop the equals-sign / double-arrow alignment rules that produce noisy whitespace-only diffs.

**Stacked on top of #2** — base branch is `feature/auto-20260507-141121`, so this should be merged after #2.

## phpcs.xml changes

- **Exclude** `Universal.Arrays.DisallowShortArraySyntax` (was forced by WPCS).
- **Add** `Generic.Arrays.DisallowLongArraySyntax` — forbid the legacy syntax going forward.
- **Exclude** `WordPress.Arrays.MultipleStatementAlignment` + `Generic.Formatting.MultipleStatementAlignment` — these rules forced pixel-perfect equals-sign and double-arrow alignment, generating large whitespace-only diffs whenever a variable was renamed or an array key added/removed.

## Codebase migration

Ran `composer phpcbf` once with the new ruleset; 34 autofixes applied across 8 files. Every `array()` literal and `array()` parameter default became `[]`. No semantic changes.

```
includes/Adapters/FluentCRM/FluentCrmAdapter.php   | 10 +++++-----
includes/Adapters/Groundhogg/GroundhoggAdapter.php |  8 ++++----
includes/Adapters/Newsletter/NewsletterAdapter.php | 10 +++++-----
includes/Admin/SettingsPage.php                    | 20 ++++++++++----------
includes/Core/AiClient.php                         |  6 +++---
includes/Core/Settings.php                         | 18 +++++++++---------
includes/Personalization/SegmentPlanner.php        |  8 ++++----
phpcs.xml                                          | 12 ++++++++++++
superdav-ai-newsletter.php                         |  6 +++---
```

## Verification

- `composer phpcs` → **0 errors**. Only the 2 pre-existing warnings on `$default` and `$match` reserved-keyword parameter names remain (unchanged by this chore, out of scope).
- `php -l` clean across every file.
- **Live regression test** on `wordpress.local:8080` (WP 7.1-alpha, Newsletter 9.2.5, AI plugin 0.7.0): all 52 integration + pipeline tests still pass (41 unit + 11 pipeline). Symlinked the chore branch into the WP plugins directory and re-ran the same `wp eval-file` test scripts used to verify #2.

## Why merge after #2

This branches off `feature/auto-20260507-141121` (the v0.2 PR) so the autofixer touches both v0.1 and v0.2 code in a single sweep. Merging this before #2 would re-introduce `array()` style in #2's adapters as conflict.

title: docs(ops): health dashboard staleness runbook — Resolves #7
body:
## Summary

- Documents the `stats-wrapper.sh` activity guard behaviour in `AGENTS.md` so future operators have a clear troubleshooting runbook when the health dashboard goes stale
- Explains the May 2026 root cause: API rate-limit silent failures made assigned issues invisible to the guard, causing 4+ days of stale dashboard
- Adds the manual-refresh procedure (run stats-wrapper while an active worker session is running for this repo)

## Root cause (from issue #7)

The `_check_health_issue_activity_guard` in `stats-health-dashboard.sh` requires at least one of: active workers, open PRs, or assigned issues visible via `gh_issue_list`. During the API rate-limit window on 2026-05-09, `gh_issue_list` failed silently (`2>/dev/null || echo "0"`), making all three checks return 0 even though issues #6 and #7 were assigned. With no active worker sessions for this repo and no cached health-issue file, the guard skipped every run from May 7–11.

## Resolution (operational)

- Triggered `stats-wrapper.sh` manually with this worker session active — dashboard refreshed to `2026-05-11T21:42:55Z`
- `last_refresh:` marker confirmed present in issue #3 body

## Verification

```
gh api repos/Ultimate-Multisite/superdav-ai-newsletter/issues/3 --jq '.body' | grep last_refresh
# output: last_refresh: 2026-05-11T21:42:55Z
```

Resolves #7
